The y-axis is labeled "Max Attn Activation Value" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600. A blue dashed line, labeled "attn_output," begins at a value of approximately 0 at x=0 and increases to approximately 100 at x=20. A blue dotted line, labeled "attn_residual," starts at approximately 0 at x=0 and increases to approximately 120 at x=20. A red dotted line, labeled "attn_residual," begins at approximately 0 at x=0 and increases to approximately 1400 at x=20. A red solid line, labeled "ffn_residual," starts at approximately 0 at x=0, increases to approximately 1100 at x=5, declines to approximately 100 at x=10, increases to approximately 1500 at x=15, and then declines to approximately 200 at x=20.
